verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents a dedicated Scheduled Flags feature that queues flag changes and automatically applies them at a specified future time, which directly covers the core of this story. Release Pipelines add automated stage progression, but the evidence does not show that those triggers are time-based. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduling, documented scheduling of whole releases or pipeline stages at a set time, details on scheduling via the API/CLI and any plan or edge-case limitations.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule flag changes and releases to happen at a specific future time

citations.quote: Scheduled flags allow you to queue and automatically apply changes to feature flags at a specified future time, eliminating the need for manual intervention at the exact moment of change.
The scheduled change will be queued and applied automatically at the specified time.
